title: 第17章 小白第18章 迷失峡谷
slug: 穿越修真界开局娶了美女大师姐
lines: 兽丹看起来个头挺大，但它就像一样，一入嘴就化作一股庞大的灵气，扩散到莫凡的四肢百骸，差点把莫凡的身体撑爆。
莫凡赶紧盘腿坐下，运转长青诀，炼化这些灵气。几个周天下来，才缓解了被撑爆的危险。但是还有庞大的灵气充盈于身体各处。
灵气经过炼化后，化作灵力的涓涓细流，汇聚到莫凡的丹田。莫凡的境界是筑基八层，丹田所化的灵力湖泊，已有六十丈见方。
兽丹灵气转化成的灵力源源不断地注入灵力湖泊，湖泊的面积又在以肉眼可见的速度慢慢扩张着。
不知过了多久，莫凡将兽丹灵气全部转化完成。此时，他的丹田灵力湖泊，已经扩张到八十丈见方。
而莫凡的修为境界，也来到了筑基九层！
效果太好了，这黑风谷没白来。
睁开眼睛，莫凡看到陆飞烟正躺在不远处的草地上，翘着二郎腿，百无聊赖的样子。
“你醒啦？修为大有长进嘛。”陆飞烟看着莫凡笑道。
“时间过去多久了？”莫凡问道。
“不久，两个时辰而已。”
“两个时辰，这么久？”
“还久？你吸收算很快了，一般来说，四阶的兽丹兽丹得吸收一天才行。应该是你修炼的功法很了不得，所以才能吸收这么快。”陆飞烟有点气他得了便宜还卖乖。
“呵呵，也许吧。”莫凡不置可否。
“快去烤一些赤炎花斑虎的肉，我等你等得肚子饿了。”陆飞烟不满地说。
“好。”莫凡切下赤炎花斑虎的一条大腿，拿到一条小溪里清洗了一下，然后燃起一堆篝火，将虎腿架在篝火上面烤。
他又从自己的储物袋里拿出一些装着作料的瓶瓶罐罐，这些都是他出门前准备的。要在黑风谷里做野外生存，莫凡也是做足了功课。
莫凡一边翻转着烤架，一边不时往烤肉上撒一些佐料。没多久，烤肉就香气四溢，陆飞烟盯着烤肉眼珠都快掉出来，不时擦擦嘴角的口水。
莫凡忍住笑，切下一块肉，用一张宽大的树叶裹着，递给陆飞烟。陆飞烟稍微吹了吹烤肉，就迫不及待地吃起来。
“嗯，真香，比上次烤的还要好吃，看来跟着你是跟对了，有这么香的烤肉吃。”
莫凡有点哭笑不得，“原来，说我下毒是假的，其实跟着我是为了吃烤肉啊？”
一不小心说漏嘴，陆飞烟也不觉得尴尬，一边吃肉一边含混不清地说：“对啊，难不成是因为你玉树临风我才跟着你吗？我溜出宗门，在这黑风谷风餐露宿的，饿了就吃野果，自己也烤肉来吃，但是味道和你烤的没法比。”
莫凡笑着摇摇头，给自己切了一块肉。他正想吃，忽然发现自己面前不知何时出现一只白发毛发的小兽。
content_en:
The beast pill looks quite big, but it is like that. As soon as it enters the mouth, it turns into a huge spiritual energy, spreading to Mo Fan's limbs and bones, and almost bursting Mo Fan's body.
Mo Fan quickly sat down cross-legged and used the Evergreen Secret to refine the spiritual energy. After a few weeks, the risk of being blown out was alleviated. But there is still huge spiritual energy filling every part of the body.
After the spiritual energy was refined, it turned into a trickle of spiritual power and gathered in Mo Fan's Dantian. Mo Fan's realm is the eighth level of foundation building, and the spiritual lake formed by his dantian is already sixty feet square.
The spiritual energy transformed from the beast elixir spiritual energy is continuously injected into the spiritual energy lake, and the area of ​​the lake is slowly expanding at a speed visible to the naked eye.
After an unknown amount of time, Mo Fan completed the transformation of all the beast elixir aura. At this time, the spiritual power lake in his Dantian had expanded to eighty feet square.
And Mo Fan's cultivation level has also reached the ninth level of foundation building!
The effect is so good, this Black Wind Valley is not in vain.
Opening his eyes, Mo Fan saw Lu Feiyan lying on the grass not far away, with his legs crossed, looking bored.
"Are you awake? You have made great progress in your cultivation." Lu Feiyan looked at Mo Fan and smiled.
"How long has it been?" Mo Fan asked.
"Soon, only two hours."
"Two hours, so long?"
"How long? You can absorb it very quickly. Generally speaking, it takes a day to absorb the fourth-level beast elixir. It should be because you have practiced great skills, so you can absorb it so quickly." Lu Feiyan was a little angry that he was taking advantage of him and still behaved.
"Haha, maybe." Mo Fan was noncommittal.
"Hurry up and grill some Chiyan spotted tiger meat. I'm getting hungry waiting for you." Lu Feiyan said dissatisfiedly.
"Okay." Mo Fan cut off a thigh of the Red Flame Spotted Tiger, washed it in a stream, then lit a bonfire and put the tiger's legs on the bonfire to roast.
He took out some bottles and jars containing ingredients from his storage bag, which he had prepared before going out. Mo Fan had done enough homework to survive in the wild in Black Wind Valley.
Mo Fan flipped the grill and sprinkled some condiments on the barbecue from time to time. It didn't take long for the aroma of the barbecue to fill the air. Lu Feiyan's eyes almost popped out of his eyes when he stared at the barbecue, and he wiped the saliva from the corner of his mouth from time to time.
Mo Fan suppressed his laughter, cut off a piece of meat, wrapped it in a wide leaf, and handed it to Lu Feiyan. Lu Feiyan blew the barbecue a little and couldn't wait to eat it.
"Well, it smells really good. It's even more delicious than the last time I grilled it. It seems that I followed you right. I have such a fragrant barbecue."
Mo Fan was a bit dumbfounded, "It turns out that it was a lie to say that I poisoned you. In fact, you followed me to eat barbecue?"
Lu Feiyan didn't feel embarrassed when he accidentally let it slip. He said vaguely while eating meat: "Yes, is it because of you Yushu Linfeng that I followed you? I slipped out of the sect and slept in the wind in the Black Wind Valley. I ate wild fruits when I was hungry. I also grilled meat to eat, but the taste is incomparable to yours."
Mo Fan smiled and shook his head, cutting himself a piece of meat. He was about to eat when he suddenly noticed a small white-haired beast appearing in front of him.
